notes.subject: דישן
notes.rationale: Dishon o hlaga fela mo, antelope ya go hlakantšha ka leina la go taboga.

notes.subject: זמר
notes.rationale: Zamer o hlaga fela mo, leina le theilwego go go theoga fase ka bofefo.

notes.subject: diphuti tša setšo
notes.rationale: Maina a mabothokopedi a Seheberu (ayal, tsvi, yakhmur, aqo, dishon, teo, zamer) ga a na mabakanyi a loka a Sepedi; mantšu a makgethwa a hlalosa sebopego sa phoofolo.

translation: Phala, le puku, le phuti, le pudi-ya-thaba, le seo-se-tabogago, le se-sweu-sethweng, le seo-se-theogago-fase-bofefo.
